metadata.title: Independent typed-edge evidence consensus
metadata.research_question: Is missing-link recovery constrained by weak support for the cause-to-deviation edge, the deviation-to-consequence edge, or both?
metadata.support_definition: Each typed edge is supported by the number of distinct eligible training scenario IDs containing that edge. Duplicate occurrences within one scenario count once.
metadata.path_join_definition: A candidate path qualifies when its cause-to-deviation edge and deviation-to-consequence edge independently meet their respective support thresholds. The edges may originate from different training scenarios.
metadata.support_scope: All training records in the target plant unit; equipment is used when plant unit is unavailable.
metadata.retrieval_scope: GraphNeighborhoodRetriever. Retrieved edges are retained only if they participate in a qualifying independently supported path.
metadata.baseline_note: The (1,1) condition is an independent-edge-support baseline. It is not expected to reproduce E1 or E2, because independently supported edges can be joined across different source scenarios.
metadata.label_warning: Reconstructed row-level associations are silver labels, not expert-validated causal ground truth.
metadata.independence_warning: Distinct scenarios may share source templates and underlying assumptions. Scenario counts do not establish statistical independence or physical confirmation.
